title: 豐田生產方式與整車裝配
titleEn: Toyota Production System and Vehicle Assembly
summary: 以「豐田生產方式與整車裝配」為案例，逐步分析顧客需求、品質內建與最小必要在製品。十個單元各有機制、定量、驗證與診斷；所有數字是教學假設，共用物理模型依案例介面選用。
summaryEn: Use Toyota production system and vehicle assembly to analyze Customer demand, built-in quality and minimum necessary WIP. Ten units connect mechanisms, calculations, verification and diagnosis. All numbers are teaching assumptions; shared physical models are selected for the case interfaces.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創汽車與交通工具教學。所有數值均為明示假設，不是同名車輛的實測規格、認證或維修設定。使用試算表、紙面圖、合成資料及自行準備的離線模型；不提供真實高壓、道路、壓力設備或控制器操作授權。
scopeEn: Original automotive teaching based on public principles. All numerical inputs are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vehicle specifications, certification criteria or maintenance settings. Use worksheets, paper diagrams, synthetic data and offline models you prepare; no authorization for real high-voltage, road, pressure-equipment or controller operations.

steps.title: 使用需求與試驗邊界｜豐田生產方式與整車裝配：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Use requirements and test boundary | Toyota production system and vehicle assembly: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 使用需求與試驗邊界｜豐田生產方式與整車裝配 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Use requirements and test boundary | Toyota production system and vehicle assembly and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 案例任務：顧客需求、品質內建與最小必要在製品。本單元觀察 看板、安燈、工站時間、裝配紀錄與瓶頸 中與「使用需求與試驗邊界」相關的介面。車型名稱不是試驗條件；先把乘員、貨物、續航與地形需求轉成載荷表。整車的輸入質量必須包含結構、能源系統及使用載荷。
steps.instructionEn: Case task: Customer demand, built-in quality and minimum necessary WIP. In kanban, andon, station timing, assembly records and bottleneck, inspect the interface related to “Use requirements and test boundary”. A vehicle name is not a test condition. Convert occupants, cargo, range and terrain needs into a load table; input mass must include structure, energy storage and operating payload.
steps.observation: 明示教學假設，不是 豐田生產方式與整車裝配 的原廠或實測規格。m_total=m_empty+m_payload；假設空車 1275 kg、載荷 225 kg。 計算結果 = 1500 kg。此為獨立教學工況；跨單元整合前先統一輸入、邊界及能量分配，再依模型限制解讀。
steps.observationEn: Explicit teaching assumptions, not manufacturer or measured specifications for Toyota production system and vehicle assembly. m_total=m_empty+m_payload; assume empty mass 1275 kg and payload 225 kg. Result = 1500 kg. This is an independent teaching operating point; reconcile inputs, boundaries and energy allocation before integrating units, then interpret within the model limits.
steps.failure: 若能耗或軸重突然改變，先核對是否把總重又加了一次電池或貨物；再比較量測日期與配置版本。
steps.failureEn: If energy use or axle load suddenly changes, first check whether the total already included the battery or cargo, then compare measurement dates and configuration versions.
steps.check: 核對每一項載荷只計入一次；用同一資料版本計算空載與滿載，保留被排除的拖車、乘員或附件。 將證據連回本案例的 看板、安燈、工站時間、裝配紀錄與瓶頸，註明照片只能證明可見配置，不能代替本步量測。
steps.checkEn: Check that every load is counted once; calculate empty and laden conditions from the same data version and list excluded trailers, people or accessories. Link evidence to this case’s kanban, andon, station timing, assembly records and bottleneck; a photograph establishes visible arrangement, not the measurement required here.

knowledge.text: 若能耗或軸重突然改變，先核對是否把總重又加了一次電池或貨物；再比較量測日期與配置版本。
knowledge.textEn: If energy use or axle load suddenly changes, first check whether the total already included the battery or cargo, then compare measurement dates and configuration versions.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 在紙面示意、試算表或自行準備的離線教學模型中完成：建立需求矩陣：使用者需求→可量測量→試驗條件→允收依據，至少列出一項本課資料不能判定的性能。 交付檔請標上 auto-v21-tps、單元 1、輸入條件與資料版本。
knowledge.textEn: Complete in a paper diagram, spreadsheet or separately prepared offline teaching model: Create a requirement-to-measurement-to-condition-to-acceptance matrix and identify one performance claim that the available evidence cannot establish. Label the evidence auto-v21-tps, unit 1, input conditions and data version.

quiz.question: 哪一項正確描述本步應診斷的失效原因？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement correctly describes the failure to diagnose?
options: 若能耗或軸重突然改變，先核對是否把總重又加了一次電池或貨物；再比較量測日期與配置版本。
看到結果符合預期就可省略條件、單位與原始資料。
車名相同就可以直接沿用另一年份的重量與試驗條件。
optionsEn: If energy use or axle load suddenly changes, first check whether the total already included the battery or cargo, then compare measurement dates and configuration versions.
An expected result allows conditions, units and raw data to be omitted.
The same model name permits weight and test conditions from another model year to be reused.
quiz.explanation: 若能耗或軸重突然改變，先核對是否把總重又加了一次電池或貨物；再比較量測日期與配置版本。 核對每一項載荷只計入一次；用同一資料版本計算空載與滿載，保留被排除的拖車、乘員或附件。 將證據連回本案例的 看板、安燈、工站時間、裝配紀錄與瓶頸，註明照片只能證明可見配置，不能代替本步量測。
quiz.explanationEn: If energy use or axle load suddenly changes, first check whether the total already included the battery or cargo, then compare measurement dates and configuration versions. Check that every load is counted once; calculate empty and laden conditions from the same data version and list excluded trailers, people or accessories. steps.title: 需求節拍與產線平衡｜豐田生產方式與整車裝配：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Demand takt and line balance | Toyota production system and vehicle assembly: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 需求節拍與產線平衡｜豐田生產方式與整車裝配 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Demand takt and line balance | Toyota production system and vehicle assembly and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 案例任務：顧客需求、品質內建與最小必要在製品。本單元觀察 看板、安燈、工站時間、裝配紀錄與瓶頸 中與「需求節拍與產線平衡」相關的介面。節拍由可用生產時間除以需求量；它是需求節奏，不是強迫每台設備以同速運轉。瓶頸、休息、品質停止與換型要分別表示。
steps.instructionEn: Case task: Customer demand, built-in quality and minimum necessary WIP. In kanban, andon, station timing, assembly records and bottleneck, inspect the interface related to “Demand takt and line balance”. Takt is available production time divided by demand: a demand rhythm, not a command that every machine run at the same speed. Bottlenecks, breaks, quality stops and changeovers need separate representation.
steps.observation: 明示教學假設，不是 豐田生產方式與整車裝配 的原廠或實測規格。t_takt=T_available/N_demand；假設可用 25200 s、需求 420 輛。 計算結果 = 60 s/vehicle。此為獨立教學工況；跨單元整合前先統一輸入、邊界及能量分配，再依模型限制解讀。
steps.observationEn: Explicit teaching assumptions, not manufacturer or measured specifications for Toyota production system and vehicle assembly. t_takt=T_available/N_demand; assume 25200 s available and demand of 420 vehicles. Result = 60 s/vehicle. This is an independent teaching operating point; reconcile inputs, boundaries and energy allocation before integrating units, then interpret within the model limits.
steps.failure: 堆料在單一工站前增加時，檢查該站週期變異、換型與品質停機；全面加速前站只會擴大在製品。
steps.failureEn: A queue before one station suggests cycle variation, changeovers or quality stops; speeding every upstream station only expands WIP.
steps.check: 列每站工作內容及循環時間分布，不以平均掩蓋長尾；確認可用時間已扣除計畫停機而未重複扣除。 將證據連回本案例的 看板、安燈、工站時間、裝配紀錄與瓶頸，註明照片只能證明可見配置，不能代替本步量測。
steps.checkEn: List station work and cycle-time distributions without hiding tails in averages; ensure planned stops are deducted once from available time. Link evidence to this case’s kanban, andon, station timing, assembly records and bottleneck; a photograph establishes visible arrangement, not the measurement required here.

steps.checkEn: List station work and cycle-time distributions without hiding tails in averages; ensure planned stops are deducted once from available time. knowledge.text: 在紙面示意、試算表或自行準備的離線教學模型中完成：以卡片排出十站裝配路徑，給每站教學週期；在不刪除檢查的前提下移動工作內容並找出瓶頸。 交付檔請標上 auto-v21-tps、單元 2、輸入條件與資料版本。
knowledge.textEn: Complete in a paper diagram, spreadsheet or separately prepared offline teaching model: Arrange a ten-station assembly route with teaching cycle times; redistribute work without deleting checks and identify the bottleneck. Label the evidence auto-v21-tps, unit 2, input conditions and data version.
